name: Golriz Ghahraman
status_detail: Resigned from Parliament effective 18 January 2024 amid shoplifting allegations; convicted on four shoplifting charges in June 2024 and fined $1,600; appealed in October 2024 seeking a discharge without conviction (outcome not confirmed in sources consulted). Not a 2026 candidate.
roles: Green spokesperson on foreign affairs, defence and justice (2017–2024)
Green spokesperson on immigration (2017–2020), ethnic communities and refugees (2020–2024)
Member, Foreign Affairs, Defence and Trade Committee (2017–2024)
